name: conventions-claude
description: Claude Code plugins that stop convention drift: a Go house canon (Go 1.27, cobra/viper, log/slog, Ginkgo, golangci-lint, goreleaser) with converge, review, and scaffold skills, and a GitHub repository canon (rulesets, pinned actions, dependabot, CodeQL, Scorecard, commitlint, PR and commit practice) with its own converge and new-repo skills

plugins.name: github-conventions
plugins.description: How a GitHub repository is created and kept hygienic — rulesets, SHA-pinned actions, dependabot, CodeQL, Scorecard, dependency review, commitlint — and how commits, pull requests, CI watching, and GitHub comments are handled; audits and converges an existing repo, scaffolds a new one

plugins.name: go-conventions
plugins.description: How Go code is written, tested, logged, linted, built, and released — Go 1.27, cobra/viper, log/slog, Ginkgo, the golangci-lint house tier, goreleaser with ko — plus skills to converge an existing repo, review a Go diff, and scaffold a new project; depends on github-conventions
